# neuthek

> neuthek is an AI-aware personal cloud storage product in active
> development. It pairs object storage (MinIO / S3-compatible) with
> a Postgres + pgvector index so users can search their library by
> natural language — "snowy roof at sunset", "whiteboard photos from
> last week's meeting" — instead of remembering filenames or scrolling.
> Photos, videos, documents (PDFs included), and source code from
> connected Google Drive accounts all live in one library. Two delivery
> modes are planned: open-source self-host (free) and managed hosted
> (waitlist). Nothing is publicly released yet.

## What neuthek is

- **AI-aware personal cloud storage.** Semantic search via OpenCLIP
  ViT-L-14 embeddings persisted in pgvector. Florence-2 captions
  every image; the caption + filename + EXIF metadata feed a hybrid
  CLIP-cosine + Postgres-FTS ranker.
- **Content-aware compression.** A LinUCB bandit picks per-image
  codec (WebP / MozJPEG / AVIF / JXL) and quality (55-92) from a
  32-dimensional context vector. Animated GIFs and detected screenshots
  bypass lossy paths.
- **Privacy-first.** EXIF metadata is stripped on upload by default;
  GPS and camera fingerprints are opt-in per scope. Postgres FORCE
  Row-Level Security fences every per-user query at the database
  layer. Refresh tokens for cloud sync are Fernet-encrypted at rest.
  Face recognition is BIPA-grade: signed-consent ledger, templates
  stay on your server, three-year auto-expiry.
- **Self-host or hosted.** The stack is FastAPI + PostgreSQL +
  pgvector + Redis + MinIO + a separate ML worker for Florence-2 /
  Qwen / RetinaFace. `docker-compose up` brings the whole thing up.
  Hosted version (managed) is in development for users who'd rather
  not run Docker.

## Stack

- API: FastAPI on Python 3.12, async SQLAlchemy, asyncpg
- Database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (1536-d / 768-d / 512-d indexes)
- Object storage: MinIO (S3 API), with optional SSE-S3 / SSE-KMS
- Cache + queue: Redis 7
- Vision: open-clip-torch (ViT-L-14), insightface (RetinaFace +
  ArcFace), microsoft/Florence-2-large via transformers, rawpy /
  LibRaw for camera RAW formats (NEF / CR2 / ARW / DNG / etc)
- ML worker: separate container so Florence-2 / Qwen inference
  doesn't hold the API container's GIL
- Auth: fastapi-users JWT + TOTP 2FA + Argon2 password hashing
- Frontend: React 18 + TanStack Query + Vite + Prism (code preview)
- Billing: Stripe Embedded Checkout (Pro + Business tiers)
- Marketing site: separate Vite SPA (this URL — neuthek.com)

## Status

In active development. The engine runs locally on a Docker compose
stack today. The hosted instance and public open-source release are
both being prepared. Users can [join the waitlist](https://neuthek.com/waitlist)
to be notified when either ships.

## Contact

For press, partnership, or self-host questions: open an issue on the
public repo (when published), or use the waitlist form to leave a
message in the optional "tell us about your use case" field.
